requirements.text: Emit immutable grounded-RDF and logical-axiom hashes for every entailed candidate returned by HermiT.
Generate deterministic reasoner-check support IDs bound to snapshot, query, BGP, authorization, graph scope and exact request identity.
Emit a closed Direct proof manifest that includes exact ontology input hashes and every answer reasoner-check record.
Prove SPARQL bag multiplicity coverage by matching one proof record to every entailed candidate contributing to each compressed solution mapping.
Emit a global completion-barrier support ID so exact empty answers remain proof-covered.
Advance Direct certificates to proof-bound format v2 while retaining format v1 validation compatibility.
Require format-v2 certificates to bind the exact proof-manifest SHA and expose only reasoner-check support references from that artifact.
Verify proof manifest, exact result and Direct certificate together at the reasoner-client trust boundary.
Emit result, proof manifest and certificate atomically under the confined reference-worker work root and verify the emitted proof artifact hash.
Keep proof construction deterministic across candidate partitions and worker completion order without expanding SPARQL duplicate rows.
Do not claim a HermiT derivation DAG; distinguish complete answer-support coverage from logical derivation provenance.
Preserve all Phase 40.8 fail-closed exactness/completeness and anonymous-individual qualification boundaries.
